name: Data Browser Process Water (Web)
implementation_notes: ProcessWaterRecordService/Controller/routes/factories are shared infrastructure for all 3 web Process Water screens (092/102/112), mirroring ThreshingRecordService's precedent -- reported under this screen since it is first in the implementation sequence

Process Water follows the exact same hourly-grid (dynamic add-row/remove-row, 1..24 rows, unique + strictly ascending canonical time_slot) pattern as ThreshingRecordService -- create()/update()/listRecords()/export()/getDetail(), plus canonicalTimeSlots() helper returning 24 'HH:00' strings starting 07:00

filled_slot_count computed via withCount() with an inner OR-whereNotNull constraint across all 11 reading columns (raw_water_flow_m3h, clarified_water_flow_m3h, softener_inlet_ph, softener_outlet_hardness_ppm, alum_dosing_kgh, polymer_dosing_gh, boiler_feed_tank_temp_c, boiler_feed_water_ph, boiler_feed_tds_ppm, action_taken_status, findings) -- mirrors ThreshingRecordService's filled_slot_count pattern; 'shift'/'inspector_id' are deliberately excluded (identifying/context columns, not readings)

UNLIKE Threshing/Pressing/Depricarping/Kernel Plant: Process Water has NO operational-target reference table -- no seeder, no model, no Target Operasional section anywhere in this station's 6 screens, per this task's explicit scope

The Process Water tile in production-process-activity.blade.php (screen-035) already existed as an active-styled tile pointing to javascript:void(0) (added by an earlier task alongside the DEFAULT_STATIONS/StationType groundwork) -- this implementation changes ONLY that one tile's href to route('data.process-water'), leaving all 16 other tiles (7 previously-routed + 8 still-unrouted 2026-08-31-batch tiles + 2 placeholders) completely unchanged

tests/Feature/ProductionProcessActivityTest.php (pre-existing, not owned by this screen) was updated additively: the Process Water assertion moved from the '9 still-unrouted' test into the '7 (now 8) active station tiles linking to their Data Browser routes' test, and both test names/counts were corrected from 9 to 8 remaining unrouted -- mirrors the exact precedent Solid Waste Disposal set for this same shared test file when its own Data Browser screen was implemented
StationFactory::processWater() state added additively (mirrors weighbridge()/grading()/threshing()/etc. exactly) for this screen's and screen-112's test suites
Ran the full backend test suite (`php artisan test`) after all changes: 1468 passed (0 failed), confirming no regression to any pre-existing screen

deferred_items.description: The mobile 'Sinkronisasi' button (Station List, screen-006) does not push locally-entered Process Water records to POST /api/process-water-records -- unlike Threshing/Pressing/Depricarping/Kernel Plant, which each have a syncProcessWaterRecords()-equivalent function wired into syncService.ts's syncAllRecords()
deferred_items.reason: Out of this 6-screen task's explicit scope; the most recent precedent station (Solid Waste Disposal) made the same deferral for the same reason. The route itself is already dual-guarded ('auth:web,sanctum' + operator role, see routes/api.php) so this is purely a mobile syncService.ts addition, not a backend change, when picked up later.

known_issues.description: Browser (Playwright) spec (backend/tests/Browser/DataBrowserProcessWaterTest.php) was authored following this codebase's established convention (a .php file containing Playwright TS syntax, excluded from phpunit.xml's testsuites, meant to be run separately via `playwright test` against a live dev server) but could not be executed in this sandboxed environment -- verified only by static review, consistent with every other Browser/* spec in this codebase.
